names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 1 iunie, «Sfântul Mucenic Hariton».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Ιουνίου, «Άγιοι Ιούστος, Ιουστίνος, Χαρίτων, Χαρίτω η παρθένος, Ευέλπιστος, Ιέραξ, Παίων και Λιβεριανός», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 1. јун ст. ст., „Свети мученик Јустин, Харитон, Харита, Евелпист, Јеракс, Пеон, Валеријан и Јуст“, which enumerates eight names and puts him second. The rank words stand once at the head of the company — Свети мученик, the `martyr` this corpus puts in `types` — and nothing else in the heading is strippable, so the form is the bare personal name the heading itself prints and no fuller form exists in this source to prefer.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and it is the same company. **He is not Charito**, the virgin whose name stands next to his in the line and who is drafted as her own folder in `el-06-01-1`: the page gives the two separate headings and one shared epigram — «Θείος Xαρίτων και Xαριτώ παρθένος, Tμηθέντες ευμοιρούσι θείων χαρίτων» — and marks her a virgin and him not. The Greek adds the persecution under Marcus Aurelius, the phalanx of Rome, the beheading and Justin the apologist beside them. No year, so no `dates`; no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 14.06.2026 (1. јун ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Јустин, Харитон, Харита, Евелпист, Јеракс, Пеон, Валеријан и Јуст“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, whose heading names him second. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. THE COMPANY OF EIGHT, AND ALL EIGHT HAVE FOLDERS. The heading enumerates eight names and the corpus keeps every one of them, which is why this entry is eight upgrades and no new folder: four of them stand in doxologia’s own calendar lines for 1 iunie (justin-companion-of-chariton, chariton-companion-of-justin, valerian-companion-of-justin, justus-1-june) and four were written off saint.gr, which names eight where the Romanian named four (charito, euelpistus, hierax-1-june, paion). All eight were already on the menologion 1/6 day list, so the day list alone found them and no grep was needed — the first time in this wave that has happened on a company. `sr-namesweep.mjs` scores only the first name of an enumerated company, its fourth known failure mode, so it was no use here either way. THE BODY IS FOUR SENTENCES AND IT GIVES THREE THINGS NONE OF THE OTHER TWO BOOKS GIVES: the place and the reign together („Сви пострадали у Риму за време Марка Аврелија и епарха Рустика“, naming Rusticus an епарх where doxologia makes him prefect of the city); the eparch’s one question and Justin’s answer to it, „Не мислимо него знамо“ — we do not think, we know; and A YEAR, 163, which is the first year any book read for any of these eight has printed. THE YEAR IS WRITTEN AS A `death` ON ALL EIGHT, AND IT IS A FIRST DATE FOR EVERY ONE OF THEM. „После тога сви беху обезглављени, 163. године“ is stated flat, of the whole company, with no „око“ and nothing to derive it from; `basis` is `traditional`, the interval is 163 to 163, and all eight folders held `dates: null` before today. No birth, no floruit and no `locations` on any of them. `types` untouched on all eight: the heading’s Свети мученик is the `martyr` they already carry, and it is the only rank word in the heading. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse. A NEW `related` ROW, RECIPROCAL: `justus-1-june`, on the same reading — one heading, eight names, one martyrdom. AND THE ONE REAL FOLD OF THE DAY. `foldchk.py` returns `[('chariton-the-martyr-9-september', 'ru')]` for «Харитон»: the Russian form of a martyr kept on 9 September is the identical string. The form is stored a second time ON PURPOSE — it is what this heading prints, one form per folder and the fullest, and the Prologue gives the company bare forenames and nothing more to distinguish them with. The two men are told apart by their days, their calendars and their companies, and the fold is named here so a later reader meets it knowing.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nestricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Iustin Martirul și Filosoful, altui Mucenic Iustin și celor împreună cu dânșii; the site prints one hymn for both Justins and their companions.

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contests received the crowns of incorruption from Thee our God; for having Thy strength they overcame the tormentors and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. At their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

death.note: Охридски пролог for 1. јун ст. ст., of the whole enumerated company of eight: „После тога сви беху обезглављени, 163. године“. Stated flat, with no „око“ and nothing to derive it from. It is the first year any book read for this folder has printed; doxologia's life gives none and saint.gr's line gives none (5 October 2026).
